title: 第1章  婚内不同房？反手炼化玄阴之体！
content_zh:
“楚枫，你想干嘛？”
地牢之中，赵雪莲被死死抵在了墙上，娇躯不断扭动。
这原本是她囚禁楚枫的地牢，可就在她即将榨干这个废物最后的纯阳之体时，竟然遭到了反噬。
楚枫抓着赵雪莲的头发，迫使她仰起下巴，露出白皙的脖颈。
“毒妇，你骗我至尊骨，废我灵根，夺我纯阳之体，你真该死啊！”
他的目光冰寒，早已和之前判若两人。
身为仙界的赤阳丹帝，楚枫没想到自己竟然重生了，而且这身体的主人也叫楚枫。
融合身体记忆之后，他很快便知道了这具身体的过往。
当初赵雪莲让楚枫必须交出他最重要的东西，来证明足够爱她。
他不顾父母阻拦，挖出了自己的至尊骨送给了赵雪莲。
没想到赵雪莲竟然是一个蛇蝎毒妇，嫁给他之后便架空楚家，还毁了他。
楚枫目光一凝，他定要让所有背叛他的人付出代价。
“你欠我的都要还回来！”
赵雪莲彻底慌了，趁着她体内灵力无法运转，这个废物竟敢对她……
“我们婚前可是有约法三章，你不准碰我，不准逼我，不准爱我！”
玄阴之体是她最大的筹码，否则她还如何转投三皇子的怀抱。
“你的纯阳之体已被我炼化，你难道还想吞噬我的玄阴之体不成？”
楚枫抓着赵雪莲的长发，冷声道。
“你的一切都是我的！”
楚枫运转炼天图，疯狂吞噬着她玄阴之体。

他之所以让赵雪莲遭到反噬，就是因为重生之时，还带回了炼天图。
此图乃是极道帝器，可炼化万物为己用。
赵雪莲瞳孔一震，下意识惊呼出声。
“楚枫，我答应你，我什么都答应你，不要毁了我的玄阴之体！”
一日一夜。
楚枫丝毫没有怜香惜玉，炼天图与他的身体融合，已经助他觉醒了太初道体。
太初道体可吞噬各种灵体，不断成长，道体的力量越强，他修炼速度也就越快。
彻底炼化了赵雪莲的玄阴之体之后，他的修为也突破到了炼气五重。
楚枫像是扔垃圾一样，将赵雪莲随手扔在了地上。
“你从我这拿走的，我会让你百倍还回来。”
赵雪莲转头恶狠狠地瞪了楚枫一眼，双腿还在微微抽搐。
“你这个畜生！你竟敢毁了我的玄阴之体！
我父亲马上就要从京师回来了，他定会扒你的皮、抽你的筋，让你死无全尸！”
楚枫嗤笑出声，抬脚踩在了她的蜜桃臀上。
“等我吞噬了你的修为，别说你爹，就算是三皇子来了，我也照杀不误。”
“你竟然还想吞噬我的修为，你敢！”
然而反应过来之后，赵雪莲不由得心头一震。
“你、你怎么会知道三皇子？”
听到这个问题，楚枫不由得目光一寒，往事一幕幕浮现在脑海。
当年赵家被人追杀逃到了青山城，他父亲见这一家人可怜，才收留了他们。

没想到，在他父母死在荒古禁地之后，赵雪莲不仅掌控了整个楚家，还将他囚禁在地牢之中。
赵家之所以做这一切，就是为了攀附那位三皇子。
“我还知道你父亲就是去京师见三皇子，因为三皇子蕴养在灵池之中的天泉雪莲已经成熟了。”
赵雪莲瞬间僵在了原地，宛若五雷轰顶。
她已经将楚枫囚禁在地牢两年多了，从来没有让其出去过，对方怎么会知道得这么清楚。
“你既然什么都知道，竟然还敢碰我！”
楚枫抡圆了手臂，一巴掌狠狠抽在了赵雪莲的脸上。
“你这一身修为都是我给你的，我能给你，自然也能拿回来。”
赵雪莲愣住了，眼中满是错愕。
往日里，楚枫对她言听计从，别说打她，就连大声说话都不敢。
如今这个眼神冰冷的男人，真的是那个对她百般讨好的舔狗吗？
“你竟然敢打我？”
既然事情都说开了，她索性也就不装了。
赵雪莲强撑着身子站起来，而后睥睨地盯着楚枫。
“三皇子答应过天泉雪莲成熟之后便会娶我，你现在把自己阉了，本王妃还能让你继续做我的狗。”
“你这样的废物，真以为三皇子还会要你吗？”楚枫反手一巴掌直接将赵雪莲抽翻在地，“带我去灵池。”
听到这话，赵雪莲一脸难以置信地盯着楚枫。
“那是三皇子的灵药，你休想染指！”
她之所以和楚枫做了三年名义上的夫妻，就是为了用楚家的灵池滋养天泉雪莲，等待灵药成熟。
如今她玄阴之体已经没有了，若是再丢了天泉雪莲，自己如何向三皇子交代。

楚枫嘴角微微抽了一下，转头拿起了墙上的一条鞭子。
这两年多，赵雪莲没少折磨他，地牢之中可是放着不少刑具。
“看来，你还没搞清楚自己的身份。”
楚枫手中鞭子狠狠甩出，一鞭子抽在了赵雪莲的嘴上。
一连十几鞭子下去，赵雪莲蜷缩在地上。
“别打了，我带你去。”
赵雪莲被折磨了一晚上，每走一步都火辣辣地疼。
她用余光恶狠狠地盯着楚枫，一会只要她先闯入灵池，夺取天泉雪莲，定能让楚枫投鼠忌器。
只要两人僵持到她父亲回来，楚枫就完了！
等着吧，我定会打断你所有骨头，一辈子都只能在地上爬！
“到了。”
眼前是一座暖阁，灵池就在暖阁之中。
赵雪莲取出一枚令牌，解开了笼罩暖阁的阵法。
楚枫紧随其后踏入暖阁，暖阁内氤氲着袅袅白雾，一汪丈许见方的灵池泛着莹白光泽。
可是他的目光被跪在门口的女子吸引了，那女子被玄铁锁链拴着，锁链另一端绕着一截钉入地面的钉仙杵。
“赵有容！”
直到女子抬头，楚枫才看清楚那凌乱长发下的绝世容颜。
眼前之人正是赵雪莲同父异母的姐姐，原本是云天宫圣女，两年前灵根被毁，被逐出了宗门。
他怎么都没想到，对方竟然被囚禁在灵池暖阁之中。
前世，赵有容是赵家唯一真心对他好的人，只可惜那个时候他的眼里只有赵雪莲。

赵有容明显愣了一下，麻木的眼眸之中逐渐泛起了一丝光亮，随即红了眼眶。
“楚枫……”
她也认出了楚枫，两多年没见，对方好似消瘦了许多。
楚枫掌心灵力骤然暴涨，钉仙杵被他直接拔了出来。
锁链上的符文崩碎，他亲手解下了她脖颈上的颈圈，颤声道。
“对不起，我来晚了。”
见到这一幕，赵雪莲甚至忘了自己来灵池的目的，忍不住呵斥道。
“她可是我赵家的罪女！你不能放了她！”
楚枫没有说话，只是冷冷地斜瞥了赵雪莲一眼。
那一个眼神，便让赵雪莲浑身一颤，下意识捂紧了自己的屁股。
content_en:
"Chu Feng, what do you want to do?"
In the dungeon, Zhao Xuelian was firmly pressed against the wall, her delicate body twisting continuously.
This was originally the dungeon where she imprisoned Chu Feng, but just when she was about to squeeze out the last pure Yang body of this waste, she suffered a backlash.
Chu Feng grabbed Zhao Xuelian's hair and forced her to raise her chin, exposing her fair neck.
"Vicious woman, you lied to me about my supreme bones, destroyed my spiritual roots, and took away my pure Yang body. You really deserve to die!"
His eyes were cold, and he was no longer the same person as before.
As the Chiyang Pill Emperor of the Immortal Realm, Chu Feng did not expect that he would be reborn, and the owner of this body would also be named Chu Feng.
After fusing the body's memory, he quickly learned the past of this body.
Back then, Zhao Xuelian asked Chu Feng to hand over his most important thing to prove that he loved her enough.
Regardless of his parents' obstruction, he dug out his Supreme Bone and gave it to Zhao Xuelian.
Unexpectedly, Zhao Xuelian turned out to be a poisonous woman. After marrying him, she ignored the Chu family and destroyed him.
Chu Feng's eyes narrowed. He was determined to make everyone who betrayed him pay the price.
"I'll pay back whatever you owe me!"
Zhao Xuelian was completely panicked. Taking advantage of the fact that the spiritual power in her body was unable to function, this loser dared to attack her...
"We had an agreement before we got married. You are not allowed to touch me, you are not allowed to force me, and you are not allowed to love me!"
The body of Xuanyin was her biggest bargaining chip, otherwise how could she switch to the third prince's arms.
"Your pure Yang body has been refined by me, do you still want to swallow my Xuanyin body?"
Chu Feng grabbed Zhao Xuelian's long hair and said coldly.
"Everything about you is mine!"
Chu Feng circulated the Heaven Refining Diagram and crazily devoured her Xuanyin body.
The reason why he caused Zhao Xuelian to suffer backlash was because he brought back the Heaven Refining Map when he was reborn.
This picture is the ultimate imperial weapon, which can refine all things for one's own use.
Zhao Xuelian's pupils trembled, and she subconsciously exclaimed.
"Chu Feng, I promise you, I promise you anything, don't destroy my Xuanyin body!"
One day and one night.
Chu Feng showed no pity for her at all. The Heaven Refining Diagram merged with his body and helped him awaken the Taoist body of Taichu.
The Taoist body of Taichu can swallow all kinds of spiritual bodies and continue to grow. The stronger the power of the Taoist body, the faster he will practice.
After completely refining Zhao Xuelian's Xuanyin body, his cultivation level also broke through to the fifth level of Qi refining.
Chu Feng threw Zhao Xuelian on the ground as if throwing away garbage.
"What you took from me, I will give you back a hundredfold."
Zhao Xuelian turned around and glared at Chu Feng fiercely, her legs still twitching slightly.
"You beast! How dare you destroy my Xuanyin body!
My father is coming back from the capital soon. He will definitely peel off your skin, beat your tendons, and leave you dead without any body parts! "
Chu Feng sneered and raised his foot to step on her peach butt.
"When I devour your cultivation, let alone your father, even if the third prince comes, I will still kill him."
"You actually want to devour my cultivation, how dare you!"
However, after reacting, Zhao Xuelian couldn't help but feel shocked.
"You, how do you know about the third prince?"
Hearing this question, Chu Feng couldn't help but his eyes went cold, and scenes from the past came to mind.
Back then, the Zhao family was being hunted and fled to Qingshan City. His father saw that the family was pitiful, so he took them in.
Unexpectedly, after his parents died in the ancient forbidden land, Zhao Xuelian not only took control of the entire Chu family, but also imprisoned him in a dungeon.
The reason why the Zhao family did all this was to cling to the third prince.
"I also know that your father went to the capital to meet the third prince because the Tianquan Snow Lotus that the third prince kept in the spiritual pond has matured."
Zhao Xuelian instantly froze on the spot, as if struck by thunder.
She has imprisoned Chu Feng in the dungeon for more than two years and has never let him out. How could the other party know so clearly.
"Since you know everything, you still dare to touch me!"
ChuFeng rounded his arms and slapped Zhao Xuelian hard on the face.
"Your cultivation is all given to you by me. If I can give it to you, I can naturally get it back."
Zhao Xuelian was stunned, her eyes full of astonishment.
In the past, Chu Feng obeyed her words and did not even dare to speak loudly, let alone hitting her.
Is this man with cold eyes really the licking dog who wants to please her in every possible way?
"How dare you hit me?"
Now that everything was out of the way, she simply stopped pretending.
Zhao Xuelian forced herself to stand up, and then stared at Chu Feng with disdain.
"The third prince promised that Tianquan Xuelian would marry me when he matured. Now that you have castrated yourself, I can still let you continue to be my dog."
"You are such a waste, do you really think that the Third Prince will still want you?" Chu Feng slapped Zhao Xuelian to the ground with a backhand, "Take me to the spiritual pool."
Hearing this, Zhao Xuelian stared at Chu Feng in disbelief.
"That's the third prince's elixir, don't get your hands on it!"
The reason why she had been a couple in name only with Chu Feng for three years was to use the Chu family's spiritual pool to nourish the Tianquan Snow Lotus and wait for the elixir to mature.
Now that her Xuanyin body is gone, how will she explain to the third prince if she loses the Tianquan Snow Lotus again.
The corner of Chu Feng's mouth twitched slightly, and he turned around and picked up a whip on the wall.
In the past two years or so, Zhao Xuelian had tortured him frequently, and there were many torture instruments placed in the dungeon.
"It seems that you haven't figured out your identity yet."
Chu Feng whipped out the whip in his hand and struck Zhao Xuelian on the mouth.
After being whipped for more than ten times in a row, Zhao Xuelian curled up on the ground.
"Stop fighting, I'll take you there."
Zhao Xuelian was tortured all night, and every step she took was in burning pain.
She stared at Chu Feng fiercely with her peripheral vision. As long as she broke into the spiritual pool first and captured the Tianquan Snow Lotus, Chu Feng would definitely be able to throw him into a trap.
As long as the two of them are in a stalemate until her father comes back, Chu Feng will be finished!
Just wait, I will break all your bones and you will have to crawl on the ground for the rest of your life!
"Arrived."
In front of you is a Nuan Pavilion, and the Lingchi is in the Nuan Pavilion.
Zhao Xuelian took out a token and unlocked the formation that enveloped Nuange.
Chu Feng followed closely and stepped into the Nuan Pavilion. The Nuan Pavilion was filled with white mist, and the spiritual pool that was about ten feet square was glowing with a white luster.
But his eyes were attracted by the woman kneeling at the door. The woman was tied by a dark iron chain, and the other end of the chain was wrapped around a nailed fairy pestle nailed into the ground.
"Zhao Yourong!"
It wasn't until the woman raised her head that Chu Feng could clearly see the peerless face under that messy long hair.
The person in front of her was Zhao Xuelian's half-sister. She was originally a saint from Yuntian Palace. Her spiritual roots were destroyed two years ago and she was expelled from the sect.
He never expected that the other party would be imprisoned in Lingchi Nuan Pavilion.
In his previous life, Zhao Yourong was the only person in the Zhao family who was truly kind to him, but it was a pity that at that time, he only had Zhao Xuelian in his eyes.
Zhao Yourong was obviously stunned for a moment. A glimmer of light gradually appeared in his numb eyes, and then his eyes turned red.
"Chu Feng..."
She also recognized Chu Feng. She hadn't seen him for more than two years and he seemed to have lost a lot of weight.
Chu Feng's spiritual power suddenly surged, and he pulled out the Immortal Pestle.
The runes on the chain shattered, and he personally removed the collar from her neck and said tremblingly.
"Sorry, I'm late."
Seeing this scene, Zhao Xuelian even forgot the purpose of coming to Lingchi and couldn't help but scolded.
"She is the guilty daughter of my Zhao family! You can't let her go!"
Chu Feng did not speak, but glanced coldly at Zhao Xuelian.
That look made Zhao Xuelian tremble all over, and she subconsciously covered her butt tightly.
